title: Storyboard
description: An agent's plan for presenting one article: a short headline and a few scenes, each answering one reader question with one template.

title.description: The headline in plain words. Shorten the article's own headline if it runs long.

dek.description: One sentence under the headline: what happened, and why a reader should care.

topic.description: Sets the page's accent colour and the label above the headline.

scenes.description: In reading order. Each scene answers a different question.

template.description: A template id from the catalog, e.g. "timeline".

question.description: The reader question this scene answers, shown as its heading, e.g. "What happens next?"

why.description: Why this template fits this question. Not shown to readers; kept so a reviewer can follow the choice.

data.description: The template's content, shaped by that template's schema.

bottom_line.description: Optional closing sentence on what this means for the reader. Leave it out when the scenes already say it.
